package.name: unitree_lidar_ros2
package.description: ROS 2 driver for an externally mounted Unitree L2 lidar, talking to the sensor directly over serial or UDP through unilidar_sdk2. Ported from the rover stack so both robots run the same driver, the same topic names and the same parameter contract. Independent of the Go2's own factory-mounted utlidar, which reaches this stack over CycloneDDS via go2_robot_sdk's raw_lidar_node instead.
